comparison.objective: Bread all faces of a chicken tender while minimizing destructive regrips; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires pressing, turning a compliant articulated food item and choosing sparse grasps. Candidate requires rigid small-tool manipulation, counterholding and fine rotary adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Record scores remaining bare surface area and final rack placement. Candidate scores dynamic carriage behavior and setting retention, with several limits unspecified.
comparison.reason: Surface coverage and regrasp planning on a semi-deformable item are unrelated to damper commissioning.
